what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tajikistan in Kyrgyzstan: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1504 Tajik asylum seekers in Kyrgyzstan, 23.4% of all asylum seekers from Tajikistan.
Refugees from Tajikistan, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tajikistan from 1995 to 1998, in 2000 and in 2010 and 2011.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan in 2021 and 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 132 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Kyrgyzstan.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Kyrgyzstan only.
